Pass the same engine/tier

tools.name: transcriptlab_discover_captions
tools.description: List the caption languages and track types (manual vs generated) available for a YouTube video. tools.name: transcriptlab_search_transcript
tools.description: Search, quote, or slice a transcript already delivered to this account. Use for "find the part where...", keyword or regex lookup, or paginating a long transcript into chunks. It never starts a fetch and never charges transcript credits, so it only works on a video already cached here: deliver it fi

tools.name: transcriptlab_get_job_status
tools.description: Check whether a transcript job from transcriptlab_get_transcript has finished. Use it when that tool returned a job_id instead of a transcript. Returns status only, delivers no transcript, and spends no credits; once it reports done, read the text with transcriptlab_retrieve_transcript.

tools.name: transcriptlab_get_usage
tools.description: Read the account plan, remaining credits, and current-period usage, plus upgrade options. Use when the user asks about cost, balance, or limits, or before a credit-spending request.

tools.name: transcriptlab_create_checkout_link
tools.description: Create a hosted Dodo checkout link bound to the user's connected TranscriptLab account (no website sign-in required). tools.name: transcriptlab_list_transcripts
tools.description: List YouTube videos whose transcripts were already delivered to this account, most recent first. Use it to find or reopen an earlier transcript. It fetches nothing and delivers no transcript. When more results exist, page with the returned cursor.

tools.name: transcriptlab_mentions
tools.description: Composer at-mention search over the account’s transcript library, used to build the @TranscriptLab picker. App-facing only: the host calls it, it returns resource links rather than transcript text, and the model should not call it.

tools.name: transcriptlab_open_audio
tools.description: Entry point the host invokes when the user opens an audio or video file with this plugin: opens the uploader view and starts speech-to-text. You do not call this directly; for a file attached to the conversation use transcriptlab_transcribe_file.

tools.name: transcriptlab_begin_audio_upload
tools.description: Create a signed direct-upload session for an opened audio file. App-facing only: the uploader view calls it, not the model.

tools.name: transcriptlab_start_audio_transcription
tools.description: Finalize a signed upload and start speech-to-text on it. App-facing only: the uploader view calls it once the file is uploaded. Spends credits per audio minute.

tools.name: transcriptlab_read_audio_transcript
tools.description: Read the transcript of a file uploaded through the uploader view. A pending transcription reports 202; retry shortly. App-facing only.

tools.name: transcriptlab_open
tools.description: Open the TranscriptLab launcher view, where the user can work with transcripts visually and send one into the chat with "Discuss in chat". findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "transcriptlab_get_transcript" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: transcriptlab_get_transcript, transcriptlab_retrieve_transcript, transcriptlab_discover_captions, transcriptlab_search_transcript, transcriptlab_get_job_status, transcriptlab_list_transcripts, transcriptlab_mentions, transcriptlab_read_audio_transcript, transcriptlab_open, transcriptlab_get_speech_transcript, transcriptlab_submit_batch, transcriptlab_transcribe_playlist · Private data: transcriptlab_get_transcript, transcriptlab_open_audio, transcriptlab_begin_audio_upload, transcriptlab_start_audio_transcription, transcriptlab_read_audio_transcript, transcriptlab_open, transcriptlab_transcribe_file, transcriptlab_transcribe_media_url, transcriptlab_export_link · Public sink: transcriptlab_begin_audio_upload, transcriptlab_start_audio_transcription, transcriptlab_open, transcriptlab_transcribe_file, transcriptlab_export_link, transcriptlab_submit_batch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: transcriptlab_get_transcript, transcriptlab_retrieve_transcript, transcriptlab_discover_captions, transcriptlab_search_transcript, transcriptlab_get_job_status, transcriptlab_list_transcripts, transcriptlab_mentions, transcriptlab_read_audio_transcript, transcriptlab_open, transcriptlab_get_speech_transcript, transcriptlab_submit_batch, transcriptlab_transcribe_playlist · Private data: transcriptlab_get_transcript, transcriptlab_open_audio, transcriptlab_begin_audio_upload, transcriptlab_start_audio_transcription, transcriptlab_read_audio_transcript, transcriptlab_open, transcriptlab_transcribe_file, transcriptlab_transcribe_media_url, transcriptlab_export_link · Public sink: transcriptlab_begin_audio_upload, transcriptlab_start_audio_transcription, transcriptlab_open, transcriptlab_transcribe_file, transcriptlab_export_link, transcriptlab_submit_batch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
